correctness.rationale: A vertex with an incoming edge has own value at least one and values any other bundle at most one by simplicity. A vertex with none can fail EFX only by retaining its incident edge after removing a zero-valued edge at its recipient, which happens exactly when the recipient has at least two incoming edges. Thus on a cycle the forbidden direction triples are cyclic 010 and 101, equivalently adjacent changes. The set of change positions is independent on C_n and even, and any such set determines two indexed words by choosing the first bit. For k≥2 even, choose a labeled start of a run and its color and compose n into k ordered run lengths at least two; division by k removes the choice of distinguished run. This gives the stated binomial layer, with the two constant words counted at k=0. The parity-filtered trace has eigenvalues of t²−t−1 and t²−t+1, proving the Lucas-plus-cosine total and the exponential probability for unbiased independent orientations. This includes n=3 and does not apply to deleting only goods positively valued by the envier.
residual_risks: The independent totals were 2,6,12,20,30,46,74,122,200,324,522,842; this finite enumeration is not proof for untested n or different valuations.

evidence: For w=2, Moser's transition map has even weight and no adjacent 1s, with precisely two preimages per transition set. Fixing weight k gives the usual circular no-adjacency count (n/k)·binom(n−k−1,k−1) for k>0, doubled for the preimages, with k=0 handled separately.
The known total on string space and the fair-orientation count agree under the 1-to-1 direction-bit map; division by 2^n and the dominant Lucas root immediately give the probability asymptotic.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The exact result follows from the known string enumeration and the direct local translation of EFX, without a new enumerative step. The transition layer is mechanically implied by the prior transition coding and gap formula even when the quantities are named differently.

originality.rationale: The indexed binary strings obtained from the EFX definition are exactly the previously counted circular strings without zigzags, not merely a class with numerically similar initial counts. The exact Lucas plus six-period formula and the transition coding with the even parity restriction predate the record. The layer and probability are direct consequences of that coding and standard cyclic gap counting. The fairness interpretation is distinguished from the already known census; it does not make this an independently new exact enumeration.
residual_risks: Historical priority for the fairness interpretation itself is not established. Full text of the 2010 circular success-run distribution paper was inaccessible; a 2023 equal-weight K_(2,2) citation could not be verified. Neither is used to infer absence or to support rejection; exact earlier combinatorial coverage is independently established.

value.rationale: Fair orientation enumeration is a natural question, but the frozen census and refinement are a direct translation of the known indexed no-zigzag count and transition model. The model-specific equivalence is a useful local observation: read the orientation bits of the central edge and its two neighboring edges to detect the only possible violation. It does not by itself establish a distinct substantive classification, a new count, or an additional phenomenon beyond the known combinatorial object. The probability asymptotic rescales the same tabulated count.
residual_risks: This is a standalone value decision for the frozen unit-cycle census; it does not deny the usefulness of the equivalence in studies of unequal weights or other graph families.
